summary: This document updates the cryptographic algorithm requirements for the Password-Based Message Authentication Code in the Certificate Request Message Format (CRMF), which is specified in RFC 4211. It moves the recommended algorithms to ones considered stronger today, so certificate requests protected by a shared password stay secure.

eli5.summary: Old locks get weaker as burglars get smarter. This document says which newer, tougher locks to use when someone asks for a digital ID card using a shared password.
